cohort: Live births in Kerman province, Iran, from March 2014 to March 2015
finding: Several factors were found to be associated with low birth weight, including preterm labor, neonate female sex, low parity, pregnancy age <18 years and >35 years, delivery by cesarean section, pregnancy risk factors, maternal illiteracy, living in rural areas, consanguinity, and delivery by obstetrician.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as a significant factor associated with low birth weight.
birth_weight: low birth weight and normal birth weight
